first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The adult man in the center with side-parted brown hair swept back and a thin mustache, wearing a long dark purple coat, white shirt, black bow tie, gray waistcoat, and light gray trousers.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The young man behind and to the right of Person A, wearing a dark purple uniform and trousers and a purple cylindrical hat with light gold lettering.

entities.name: red patterned carpet
entities.identification: The red-based carpet extending along the lobby passage, with a light-colored border and repeating patterns.

entities.name: large potted palm
entities.identification: The large plant with dark green pinnate leaves behind Person I and Person A, with its crown spreading outward and most of its pot occluded.

entities.name: Person G
entities.identification: The adult woman on the right, wearing a long beige coat, black skirt, and dark fur collar, with a round black hat, holding Animal A against her chest.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The small black long-haired dog held horizontally against Person G's chest, with its head on the right side of the image.

entities.name: Person I
entities.identification: The adult man on the left, wearing a tall white hat, white double-breasted top, and long white apron, holding the brown folder with an emblem.

entities.name: brown folder with an emblem
entities.identification: The brown rectangular board-like folder held by Person I, with an outline drawing of a crown and the letters GB on the front.

entities.name: cream-pink wall and arched niche
entities.identification: The light warm pink walls on the right side and at the far end of the lobby, with arched areas, light-colored borders, and decorative lines.

entities.name: golden-brown stone-faced column
entities.identification: The tall golden-brown stone-faced columns arranged from near to far along the left side of the image, with light and dark textures and dark dividing lines.

entities.name: warm-white globe lights and wall lights
entities.identification: The groups of warm-white globe lights suspended below the ceiling and the small lights along the arch edges and walls.

entities.name: wood-framed upholstered chair in the lobby
entities.identification: The dark-framed upholstered chairs in the lounge area, with brown to light brown cushions, recorded together as objects of the same type.

entities.name: small round table in the lobby
entities.identification: The dark round tables in the lobby lounge area; the round table at the left edge in the later part of the clip supports a table lamp.

entities.name: guests and staff in the background
entities.identification: The group of people standing, passing through, or seated in the rear of the lobby, excluding Person A, Person B, Person G, and Person I.

entities.name: glossy black handbag
entities.identification: The glossy black handbag hanging in front of Person G toward image-right, horizontally rectangular with short handles.

entities.name: light-colored ceiling
entities.identification: The flat light pink ceiling above the lobby, with straight decorative moldings visible along its junction with the walls.

entities.name: geometric-patterned floor
entities.identification: The light-colored flooring beside the red patterned carpet, with dark outlines and repeating floral and curved motifs.

entities.name: cups and saucers on the tabletop
entities.identification: The collection of light-colored cups and saucers and small reflective vessels on tables in the lounge area.

entities.name: dark dome-shaded table lamp
entities.identification: The dark table lamp on the round table at the left edge, with a domed shade, slender vertical stem, and base.
